summary: A diary says who listened alongside the writer, or that nobody did.
realLife: Mass Observation diarists noted who in a pub or at home listened to the King's broadcast and who paid it no attention.
sources: Sussex Library, Mass Observation 12 May 1937 and 2023 coronation-day diaries: https://blogs.sussex.ac.uk/librarycollections/2024/05/02/i-am-not-interested-in-the-coronation-similarities-and-dissimilarities-in-mass-observations-12th-may-diaries-from-1937-and-2023/
inGame: The `watched` move of the diary's first evening, gated on `we`, `watched-many` or `alone`.
